create_recipe_arguments: create a RecipeArguments instance with a recipe path and stage for oneshot compression

test_clear_sparse_session: test RecipeArguments with clear_sparse_session enabled to reset compression session data between runs

review_recipe_arguments: review the RecipeArguments dataclass and its fields for configuring LLM compressor recipe sessions
